prompts.hypothesis: Baseline: byte-identical to the production P1 prompt (contracts/incident_extraction_prompt.txt) at incident-contract-v4.

Severity is over-rated on dev (ground-truth level 3 predicted 4 or 5 in 24 of 38 Stage 1 outputs). Stating the guidelines' severity decision rules (annotation-guidelines-v1.0 §2.3: observed harm and demonstrated danger, visible indicators per level, property alone, the evidence-conditional tie-break) improves severity exact accuracy without lowering other scores.

Entities are over-listed on dev (85-102 predicted against 55-72 ground-truth entities in Stage 1). Applying the guidelines' role test (annotation-guidelines-v1.0 §3) raises entity precision without lowering recall.

Instruments are under-reported on dev (9 predicted against 18-25 ground-truth instruments in Stage 1). Applying the existing instrument definition explicitly to each entity (annotation-guidelines-v1.0 §4, §6) raises instrument recall without adding non-instruments.

Assets are over-listed on dev (about 105 predicted against 41 ground-truth assets in Stage 1). Requiring a visible role for each asset (annotation-guidelines-v1.0 §5) raises asset precision without lowering recall.

The incident description passes the judge in 27-47% of dev outputs in Stage 1 and is unstable between repeats. Stating the guidelines' general description principles (annotation-guidelines-v1.0 §2.4, §7: event, who, key action, observable outcome; observable verbs; completeness and consistency with the structured fields) improves description scores. It contains no example sentence and no ground-truth wording.

End timestamps (47-50% within 5 s) and duration (32-38%) are the weakest timing fields on dev in Stage 1. Stating how to locate the boundaries (annotation-guidelines-v1.0 §2.2) improves end and duration accuracy without lowering start accuracy.

Two outputs were contract-invalid in Stage 1 (VSS arm) and cross-field consistency is not checked by the model. An explicit final consistency check (annotation-guidelines-v1.0 §6, §8; prompt §8) raises the valid-output rate and consistency without lowering any score.

V8 by the combination rule fixed before Stage 2: p1-v4-base with the inserted block of every V1-V7 version whose recovery-adjusted Stage 2a D9 v2 comparison has Delta I > 0 and no G1-G3 problem (all seven), applied unchanged in section order. Combining the blocks improves Delta I over p1-v4-base without a G2 regression; the blocks are not assumed to add up.

Baseline: byte-identical to the production P1 prompt (contracts/incident_extraction_prompt.txt) at incident-contract-v5. Adds the asset name and description hedge and the optional last_handled_by; p1-v4-base stays as the older baseline.
